text:
Amanda R: Heads up team — I just ran the reviewer import and ~50 people are reporting the review form is locked when they try to edit. Getting this popup: 

Error: This form is currently being processed by the system. Try again later. (code: FORM_LOCKED)

Amanda R: I only imported a small batch. Not sure why some users who already submitted earlier are now locked out. Anyone seen FORM_LOCKED before? :eyes:

Ben S: Ugh. Can you drop one sample user so I can check import logs and forms-service traces?

Amanda R: Sent a DM with jen@redwood.ai. She says she submitted this morning and now can't reopen to make a minor correction. Screenshot attached.

People Ops Bot: Incident created: INC-2462 — "Review form locked after bulk reviewer import". Assigned to people-ops oncall.

Liam K: Quick triage plan: 1) check import job traces for duplicate upserts 2) grep for 409 or LOCK responses from forms-service 3) if many users affected, prepare a temporary read/write override for affected form ids.

Ben S: I see the import retried a webhook and forms-service returned 409 at 1768439951. Looks like around 47 distinct user form rows hit the locking logic. Exporting the affected ids now.

Jess M: For short-term mitigation: option A) clone affected forms and share new links with affected reviewers (messy for managers), option B) flip an ops toggle to clear FORM_LOCKED for those ids, option C) pause automatic handback enforcement for 24h. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Amanda R: Cloning is workable for a handful but will break tracking for managers. If we use clones, we need to send a clear mapping and ask managers to accept temporary duplicates. Prefer ops-toggle + quick rollback if possible.

Ben S: I'm preparing a rollback of the last import job (PR #3432). Also adding a non-invasive toggle to clear lock flags for the exported ids so we can re-open forms immediately while rollback is validated.

People Ops Bot: INC-2462 update: rollback PR opened, ops-toggle created, affected users exported to /internal/people-ops/incidents/INC-2462/affected_reviewers.csv

Liam K: After rollback merges I'll run a reindex of the forms table and sweep lock flags. Estimated 30-40m. I'll post updates here.

Jess M: I'll draft manager comms: what happened, who was affected, whether we used clones, and the timeline. Also include steps to escalate if someone reports missing submissions.

Ben S: Rollback merged at 1768440355. Triggering reindex job now.

People Ops Bot: INC-2462 status: reindex started.

Liam K: Reindex finished, lock flags cleared at 1768440580. Spot-checked Jen and a couple others — they can reopen and edit forms normally.

Amanda R: Verified with Jen via DM — edits persist. Thanks everyone. Jess, please send the manager note and mark affected folks for manual check-ins. Closing the manual callbacks after manager confirmations. :pray:

Jess M: Will do. Draft going out in 10min with affected list and instructions.

People Ops Bot: INC-2462 resolved and closed at 1768440650.
